{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: on-demand executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow — ask_advisor, review gates, usage ledger, privacy tiers","id":"gh:1399398526","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-advisor-flow","slug":"ccll/dsh-advisor-flow","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: on-demand executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow — ask_advis"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"or, review gates, usage ledger, privacy tiers"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-advisor-flow"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that ports the pi-advisor-flow executor/advisor workflow to DSH. Eve"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ryday work runs on the everyday model; at key decisions, after repeated failures and before a turn c"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"loses, a stronger advisor model provides a second opinion. The advisor only advises — it never takes"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" over the work (no tools, no file edits), and the session owner keeps full configurability and visib"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ility over cost, privacy and blocking behavior."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Observable behavior is aligned with pi-advisor-flow 0.8.2 (divergences are listed item by item in `R"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"avior is aligned with pi-advisor-flow 0.8.2 (divergences are listed item by item in `RATIONALE.md`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The same clean isolated environment: the web settings card (also in dark, with the guideline gates &"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" privacy tiers in dark) and the /advisor status readout with per-call usage, gate decision stats and"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"dark) and the /advisor status readout with per-call usage, gate decision stats and remaining budget."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **On-demand consultation**: the executor calls the `ask_advisor` tool whenever it wants a second o"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"pinion — with no arguments for a general review, or with a question, a draft, a repo-context tier (i"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"t can only narrow the owner's allowed tier) and a hand-picked file list. Every answer carries an `ad"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"viceId` for later reference.
- **Manual consultation**: the session owner can trigger a consultation"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" at any time with `/advisor-manual [focus]`, and cancel one in flight with `/advisor cancel`.
- **Ha"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"rd loop gate**: when the same tool call with an equivalent signature repeats up to the threshold (de"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"fault 3), the host intercepts the call *before* it executes and asks the advisor to review; the advi"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"sor answers with a three-value decision — `proceed | revise | blocked` — and `blocked` is handled ac"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"cording to the configured blocking mode (`warn-and-continue | block-tool | block-session`).
- **Exec"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"utor guidelines**: before-plan / after-failure / before-completion guidelines are injected into the "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"system prompt as soft constraints (on by default; the text matches the pi 0.8.2 English original ver"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"batim).
- **Hard completion review (default mode)**: in the default *hard* intervention mode, every "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"executor turn is reviewed by the advisor before it closes; a `revise` or `blocked` verdict sends the"},{"id":"p8s14","text":" full advice back to the executor to keep working. In *soft* mode the plugin behaves exactly like pi"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"-advisor-flow: guidelines only.
- **Outcome recording**: the `record_advisor_outcome` tool lets the "},{"id":"p8s16","text":"executor voluntarily record whether an advice was followed and validated (one-shot JSONL entries, ad"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"vice text stored as an HMAC hash; off by default).
- **Usage ledger and status**: per-call and cumul"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ative input/output/cache tokens with cost details, categorized by trigger (on-demand / manual / gate"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"); `/advisor status` shows the model routing, gate state and gate decision statistics.
- **Privacy t"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"iers**: repo context `off | summary | full`, file contents never leave the machine without an indepe"},{"id":"p8s21","text":"ndent opt-in (ownership-checked), and secret-shaped values are replaced with placeholders before any"},{"id":"p8s22","text":"thing is sent — redaction runs *before* truncation.

Version assumptions about DSH's plugin seams are declared in `package.json` under `dsh.compat`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- DSH web, tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` (see `dsh.compat` in `package.json`).
- An a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"dvisor model reachable through DSH's own model routing — pick any provider/model already configured "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"in DSH; the plugin reuses the host LLM service and never talks to providers directly."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Configuration lives in the `advisor-flow` namespace of `settings.yaml` and can also be edited in the"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" web settings card. Changes apply live, no restart needed. Highlights:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Enable prerequisites: `advisor-flow.enabled: true` plus `advisor.provider` / `advisor.model`; with"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" an incomplete configuration the whole feature stays disabled and the reason is queryable via `/advi"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"sor status`.
- `mode` — intervention strength: `hard` (default; forces a completion review before ev"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ery turn closes) or `soft` (guidelines only, pi behavior).
- `advisor.callTimeoutMs` — overall timeo"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ut for one consultation, default 600000 ms (10 minutes).
- `advisor.maxTokens` — output cap for one "},{"id":"p19s6","text":"consultation; by default it follows the host's configured cap for the selected model.
- Loop-gate th"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"reshold defaults to 3 (minimum 2); the three guidelines and the loop gate are on by default; secret "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"redaction is off by default (enable it in the settings card — recommended, secret-shaped values are "},{"id":"p19s9","text":"then sent as placeholders).
- `privacy.repoContext` (`off | summary | full`, default `summary`), `pr"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"ivacy.fileContent` / `privacy.untrackedContent` / `privacy.trackedFileContent` (default `false`), pe"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"r-tool disclosure policies via `toolPolicies`.
- For the full key list, `lib/config.js` is the sourc"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"e of truth for the namespace contract, and `SOLUTION.md#产品契约` documents every key with its default."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Commands"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- `/advisor-manual [focus]` — start a manual consultation immediately; cancel one in flight with `/a"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"dvisor cancel`.
- `/advisor [on|off|toggle|status|gates|cancel]` — session-level switch and status q"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ueries; bare `/advisor` toggles."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Commit and verification gates (AgentMap living docs + `.githooks/`) are described in `CONVENTIONS.md"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"mmit and verification gates (AgentMap living docs + `.githooks/`) are described in `CONVENTIONS.md`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Acknowledgments & Disclaimers"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE for the full text."}],"truncated":true}
